list_waiting_candidates.description: Find the candidates in your own Greenhouse account who have sat in the same interview stage for a number of days or more, such as 5 for a daily nudge. Time is counted from the day the candidate entered the stage they are in now, not from the last note or email. Each candidate comes with their name, job, stage, the date they entered it, days waiting, their recruiter's name and email, and a link to them in Greenhouse. The same candidates also come grouped by recruiter, so emailing each recruiter their own list is one loop with no filter, lookup or grouping step. Only candidates still in the running are looked at. Needs the Harvest credential on the Greenhouse connection.

description: Read any company's public Greenhouse job board: list and search its open roles, newest first or since a date, pull a job post's full description, pay ranges and application questions, browse its departments, offices, and prospect sections, and start a workflow when a new job is posted, all with no API key. Add your organization's Job Board API key to also submit applications to your own job posts, and its Harvest client ID and secret to start a workflow when a candidate reaches a stage such as Offer, to list the interviewers who still owe a scorecard, and to list the candidates who have been waiting in a stage, grouped by recruiter. With the same Harvest credential it starts a workflow when someone applies, with their resume and the job description ready for an AI step, lists and reads applications, finds candidates, lists the day's interviews, and adds notes to a candidate's profile.
